source: Two brief Spanish instructions during ordinary work; saved together
lessonTheme: Crea este juego and en un repositorio separado
summary: Correctly used crea este juego, por favor after a recall invitation. English repository wording and in were supplied as repositorio separado and en. No corrected retry was observed.

observations.learnerText: Crea este juego, por favor en un separate repository
observations.correctedText: Crea este juego en un repositorio separado, por favor.
observations.outcome: Correct crea este juego and por favor; juego was supplied with the prompt. Tutor supplied repositorio separado for the mixed English phrase and a natural word order. No mastery inferred.
Reused crea and este. Tutor supplied en and repositorio, accented sí, and offered créalo as a natural explicit-object alternative. The learner did not produce or retry créalo.

nextSteps: Recall en un repositorio separado after a gap.
Keep successful crea este ... commands in use; offer an optional attached-object contrast later.
assessmentNote: Separate correct command use from tutor-supplied vocabulary, written accents, and the unattempted créalo alternative.
